title.zh-CN: 更清晰的空间扫描与更安全的后台诊断
title.en: Clearer disk scanning and safer background diagnostics

items.zh-CN: 磁盘扫描页面重新整理为一个聚焦的工作区，扫描范围、模式、实时进度和结果不再堆叠成多组重复卡片；扫描中的环形动画也已恢复。
items.en: The disk scanning page is now organized as one focused workspace, so scan targets, modes, live progress and results no longer appear as stacks of repetitive cards; the animated scanning rings have also returned.

items.zh-CN: 后台进程诊断不再因为进程由 launchd 接管就将其判定为残留；系统服务、XPC 服务和应用扩展会识别为受管理进程，只有持续观察到原应用退出后仍在运行的任务才会提示检查。
items.en: Background process diagnostics no longer label a process as leftover merely because launchd adopted it. System services, XPC services and app extensions are recognized as managed, and a review is suggested only after CoreRobin continuously observes a task outliving its original app.

items.zh-CN: 移除了可能误伤正常服务的一键批量结束操作；可能残留的后台任务现在需要逐项查看并请求结束，执行前会再次核对进程身份和当前管理状态。
items.en: The one-click bulk termination action that could affect normal services has been removed. Possible leftover tasks are now reviewed and asked to quit individually, with process identity and current management state checked again before the action runs.
